title: Liberty Flyby
premise: A short-session arcade flyer where the player pilots a small aircraft past the Statue of Liberty skyline route, dodging vertical hazards and collecting pickups while the presentation can be remixed into many alternate art styles.
interaction_model: One-button tap-or-space control; tap to climb during play and tap to advance a brief intro cutscene; menu navigation via touch-friendly buttons.
objective: Stay airborne, avoid top and bottom obstacle columns, and collect score items for as long as possible.
progression: Runs begin from a menu, optionally pass through a short cutscene, then enter endless survival play; score rises through collectibles and difficulty increases gradually as speed ramps every few points; failure leads to a game-over screen with restart or menu return.
theme: Arcade sightseeing flight around a Liberty landmark, wrapped in a playful style-remix framework.
mood: Bright, punchy, whimsical, and replay-focused with a light toy-like arcade feel.
likely_audience: Casual players, mobile-first arcade fans, and players who enjoy fast retries, simple controls, and cosmetic theme variants.
confidence_notes: High confidence that the core loop is a Flappy Bird-like endless flyer built as a side-scrolling survival score chase.
High confidence that style selection is cosmetic only and does not materially alter rules.
Moderate confidence that the intended fantasy is a sightseeing flyby rather than a traditional aircraft simulator.
Moderate confidence in taxonomy mapping because the provided mechanic universe lacks a direct flappy-flyer category.
recreation_prompt: Create a polished browser arcade game called "Liberty Flyby" that plays like a side-view one-button endless flying runner: the player controls a small plane with tap or space to flap upward against gravity, trying to survive as long as possible while flying past a Statue of Liberty themed skyline route. Build it around a full-screen canvas with layered menu UI, a score HUD, a short pre-run radio-dialogue cutscene, and a game-over panel. During active play, the plane stays near the left side while the world scrolls right-to-left; rectangular obstacle pillars spawn from the top or bottom and cause instant failure on collision, while small floating collectible items award points and slightly increase game speed every 5 pickups. Add a large stylized Liberty landmark in the background, drifting clouds/parallax, responsive mobile-safe layout, upbeat arcade audio, and quick feedback effects for collecting items and crashing. Include a style-selection menu that remaps the exact same course into multiple cosmetic themes such as classic Liberty, stone age, neon, sketch, toy brick, bubbles, glitch, gothic, holiday, and other playful variants, plus a camera zoom selector. Keep the tone colorful, cheeky, and highly replayable, emphasizing short runs, instant restarts, readable obstacles, and a clean tap-to-climb survival loop.
